usage:
import os

from openai import Client

client = Client(
    api_key=os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY"),
)

result = client.admin.organization.projects.api_keys.list("project_id", limit=20, after="after")
print(result)

fields.name: limit
fields.description: A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 100, and the default is 20.

fields.name: after
fields.description: A cursor for use in pagination. `after` is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, ending with obj_foo, your subsequent call can include after=obj_foo in order to fetch the next page of the list.

fields.name: object
fields.description: The object type, which is always `organization.project.api_key`

fields.name: redacted_value
fields.description: The redacted value of the API key

fields.name: name
fields.description: The name of the API key

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: The Unix timestamp (in seconds) of when the API key was created

fields.name: last_used_at
fields.description: The Unix timestamp (in seconds) of when the API key was last used.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The identifier, which can be referenced in API endpoints
